text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Musa Bin Bakr who said, ‘I said to Zurara that Bukeyr narrated to me, from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> that the brothers of the father, and the sister of the fathers and the mother would be increased and decreased because these would not be more shares that the brother and the sisters of the father and the mother, even though they had been in their places, because Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic is Saying that a person dies and there is no child for him, and for him is a sister, so for her is a halve of what is left, and he would be inheriting her, if there does not happen to be a child for her, Saying that he would be inheriting the entirety of her wealth, if there does not happen to be a child for her. But they are giving to the one whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Named the half for him, the whole, and resorting to giving to the one for whom Allah<sup>azwj</sup> has Named to be the whole of the wealth, less than the half. And the woman would never ever be with a share more than the man, even though she may be in his place’. He (the narrator) said, ‘So Zurara said, ‘And this is established in the presence of our companions, who are not differing with regards to it’.

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A brother from the father, and the grandfather?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The wealth is between the two of them, equally’.

citation.arabic_text: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ سِنَانٍ قَالَ قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) أَخٌ لِأَبٍ وَ جَدٌّ قَالَ الْمَالُ بَيْنَهُمَا سَوَاءً .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr and Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, altogether from Umar Bin Azina, from Zurara who said, ‘I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> about the Obligations (legislated share of inheritance) of the grandfather, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No one from the people knows what he says with regards to it except by the opinion, except for Ali<sup>asws</sup>, for he<sup>asws</sup> said with regards to it with the words of Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>’. Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Al Washa, from Aban Bin Usman, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, similar to it’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ فَرِيضَةِ الْجَدِّ فَقَالَ مَا أَعْلَمُ أَحَداً مِنَ النَّاسِ قَالَ فِيهَا إِلَّا بِالرَّأْيِ إِلَّا عَلِيٌّ ( عليه السلام ) فَإِنَّهُ قَالَ فِيهَا بِقَوْلِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) . الْحُسَيْنُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ مُعَلَّى بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ عَلِيٍّ الْوَشَّاءِ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ عُثْمَانَ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) مِثْلَهُ .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Umar Bin Azina, from Zurara and Bukeyr and Al Fazl and Muhammad and Bureyd, (It has been narrated) from one of the two (5<sup>th</sup> or 6<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) having said: ‘The grandfather is with the brothers from the father, becoming like one from the brothers, whatever (number) they reach’. He (the narrator) said, ‘I said, ‘A man left his brother from this father and his mother, and his grandfather’, or I said, ‘Left his grandfather, and his brother from this father and his mother’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The wealth is (divided) between them, even if there were two brothers or a hundred thousand, so for his would be like the share of one of the brothers’. He (the narrator) said, ‘I said, ‘A man left his grandfather and his sister’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the male is like the portion of two females, and even if there were two sisters, so the half would be for the grandfather, and the other half for the two sisters, even if they were to be more than that. Thus, it is upon this calculation, if he were to leave brothers and sisters from the father and mother, or from the father, and a grandfather, so, for the grandfather is one (with the) brothers. So the wealth is (divided) between them, for the male being the like of the portion of the two females’.

text: And from him, from Ubeys Bin Hisham, from Mushma’al Bin Sa’ad, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who left five brothers and a grandfather. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is from six (shares), for every one among them, a share’.

citation.arabic_text: رَجُلٍ تَرَكَ خَمْسَةَ إِخْوَةٍ وَ جَدّاً قَالَ هِيَ مِنْ سِتَّةٍ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمْ سَهْمٌ .

citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (3/164)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Al A’ala Bin Razen, from Abdullah Bin Bukeyr, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘The brothers are with the grandfather, meaning father of the father, would be apportioned as the brothers from the father and the mother, and the brothers from the father. citation.arabic_text: الْإِخْوَةُ مَعَ الْجَدِّ يَعْنِي أَبَا الْأَبِ يُقَاسِمُ الْإِخْوَةَ مِنَ الْأَبِ وَ الْأُمِّ وَ الْإِخْوَةَ مِنَ الْأَبِ يَكُونُ الْجَدُّ كَوَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمْ مِنَ الذُّكُورِ .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali Bin Raib, from Zurara who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who left his brother from his father and his mother, and his grandfather. citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ رَجُلٍ تَرَكَ أَخَاهُ لِأَبِيهِ وَ أُمِّهِ وَ جَدَّهُ قَالَ الْمَالُ بَيْنَهُمَا نِصْفَانِ وَ لَوْ كَانَا أَخَوَيْنِ أَوْ مِائَةً كَانَ الْجَدُّ مَعَهُمْ كَوَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمْ لِلْجَدِّ مَا يُصِيبُ وَاحِداً مِنَ الْإِخْوَةِ قَالَ وَ إِنْ تَرَكَ أُخْتَهُ فَلِلْجَدِّ سَهْمَانِ وَ لِلْأُخْتِ سَهْمٌ وَ إِنْ كَانَتَا أُخْتَيْنِ فَلِلْجَدِّ النِّصْفُ وَ لِلْأُخْتَيْنِ النِّصْفُ قَالَ وَ إِنْ تَرَكَ إِخْوَةً وَ أَخَوَاتٍ مِنْ أَبٍ وَ أُمٍّ كَانَ الْجَدُّ كَوَاحِدٍ مِنَ الْإِخْوَةِ لِلذَّكَرِ مِثْلُ حَظِّ الْأُنْثَيَيْنِ .

text: Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Abu Ubeyda, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who died and left his wife, and his sister, and his grandfather. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This is from four shares – for the wife is the quarter, and for the sister is one share, and for the grandfather are two shares’.

citation.arabic_text: رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَ تَرَكَ امْرَأَتَهُ وَ أُخْتَهُ وَ جَدَّهُ قَالَ هَذَا مِنْ أَرْبَعَةِ أَسْهُمٍ لِلْمَرْأَةِ الرُّبُعُ وَ لِلْأُخْتِ سَهْمٌ وَ لِلْجَدِّ سَهْمَانِ .

citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (23/165)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammaad Bin Usman, and Jameel Bin Darraj, from Ismail Bin Abdul Rahman Al Ju’fy, (The narrator says), ‘I heard Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> saying, ‘The grandfather is apportion as the brothers, whatever (number) they reach, and even if they were a hundred thousand’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ الْجَدُّ يُقَاسِمُ الْإِخْوَةَ مَا بَلَغُوا وَ إِنْ كَانُوا مِائَةَ أَلْفٍ .

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) أَخٌ لِأَبٍ وَ جَدٌّ قَالَ الْمَالُ بَيْنَهُمَا سَوَاءً .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Sinan who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who left his brother from his mother, not having left an inheritor apart from him’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The wealth is for him’. I said, ‘So if there was a brother from the father, and a grandfather?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The wealth would be (divided) between the two of them, equally’.

I said, ‘So if there was a brother from the father, and a grandfather?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The wealth would be (divided) between the two of them, equally’.

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who died and left his father, and his uncle, and his grandfather. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The father blocks the grandfather. The inheritance is for the father and there is nothing for the uncle and the grandfather’.

citation.arabic_text: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَبِي حَمْزَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَ تَرَكَ أَبَاهُ وَ عَمَّهُ وَ جَدَّهُ قَالَ فَقَالَ حَجَبَ الْأَبُ الْجَدَّ الْمِيرَاثُ لِلْأَبِ وَ لَيْسَ لِلْعَمِّ وَ لَا لِلْجَدِّ شَيْ‏ءٌ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who died and left his father, and his uncle, and his grandfather. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The father blocks the grandfather. The inheritance is for the father and there is nothing for the uncle and the grandfather’.

text: And from him and Ali Bin Abdullah, both together from Ibrahim, from Abdullah Bin Ja’far who said, ‘I wrote to Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A woman died and left her husband, and her parent, or her grandfather, or her grandmother. How should her inheritance be distributed?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> signed: ‘For the husband is the half, and what remains, so it is for the two parents’. And it has also been reported as well that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the one-sixth for the grandfather and the grandmother’.

citation.arabic_text: وَ عَنْهُ وَ عَلِيِّ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ جَمِيعاً عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ قَالَ كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ ( عليه السلام ) امْرَأَةٌ مَاتَتْ وَ تَرَكَتْ زَوْجَهَا وَ أَبَوَيْهَا أَوْ جَدَّهَا أَوْ جَدَّتَهَا كَيْفَ يُقْسَمُ مِيرَاثُهَا فَوَقَّعَ ( عليه السلام ) لِلزَّوْجِ النِّصْفُ وَ مَا بَقِيَ فَلِلْأَبَوَيْنِ وَ قَدْ رُوِيَ أَيْضاً أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَطْعَمَ الْجَدَّ وَ الْجَدَّةَ السُّدُسَ .
citation.translation: And from him and Ali Bin Abdullah, both together from Ibrahim, from Abdullah Bin Ja’far who said, ‘I wrote to Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A woman died and left her husband, and her parent, or her grandfather, or her grandmother. How should her inheritance be distributed?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> signed: ‘For the husband is the half, and what remains, so it is for the two parents’. And it has also been reported as well that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the one-sixth for the grandfather and the grandmother’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said that: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the one-sixth for the grandmother’.

citation.arabic_text: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَطْعَمَ الْجَدَّةَ السُّدُسَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said that: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the one-sixth for the grandmother’.

text: From him, from Jameel Bin Darraj, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the grandmother, mother of the father, with the sixth, and her daughter was alive, and provided the grandmother, mother of the mother with the one-sixth, and her daughter was alive’.

citation.arabic_text: عَنْهُ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَطْعَمَ الْجَدَّةَ أُمَّ الْأَبِ السُّدُسَ وَ ابْنُهَا حَيٌّ وَ أَطْعَمَ الْجَدَّةَ أُمَّ الْأُمِّ السُّدُسَ وَ ابْنَتُهَا حَيَّةٌ .
citation.translation: From him, from Jameel Bin Darraj, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the grandmother, mother of the father, with the sixth, and her daughter was alive, and provided the grandmother, mother of the mother with the one-sixth, and her daughter was alive’.

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the grandmother with the one-sixth, and did not Obligate (legislate) anything for her’.

citation.arabic_text: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ ابْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَطْعَمَ الْجَدَّةَ السُّدُسَ وَ لَمْ يَفْرِضْ لَهَا شَيْئاً .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the grandmother with the one-sixth, and did not Obligate (legislate) anything for her’.

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazal, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Zurara who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> provided the grandmother with the one-sixth as a provision’.

citation.arabic_text: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ الْمُغِيرَةِ عَنْ مُوسَى بْنِ بَكْرٍ عَنْ زُرَارَةَ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ إِنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَطْعَمَ الْجَدَّةَ السُّدُسَ طُعْمَةً .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazal, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Zurara who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> provided the grandmother with the one-sixth as a provision’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Sa’ad Bin Abu Khalaf, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Abdullah, said, ‘I came over to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and in his<sup>asws</sup> presence was Aban Bin Taghlub. So I said, ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Keep you well! My daughter died and my mother is alive’. So Aban said, ‘There is nothing for your mother’. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Glory be to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Give her the one-sixth!’

citation.arabic_text: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ سَعْدِ بْنِ أَبِي خَلَفٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنِ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) وَ عِنْدَهُ أَبَانُ بْنُ تَغْلِبَ فَقُلْتُ أَصْلَحَكَ اللَّهُ إِنَّ ابْنَتِي هَلَكَتْ وَ أُمِّي حَيَّةٌ فَقَالَ أَبَانٌ لَيْسَ لِأُمِّكَ شَيْ‏ءٌ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ أَعْطِهَا السُّدُسَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Sa’ad Bin Abu Khalaf, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Abdullah, said, ‘I came over to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and in his<sup>asws</sup> presence was Aban Bin Taghlub. So I said, ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Keep you well! My daughter died and my mother is alive’. So Aban said, ‘There is nothing for your mother’. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Glory be to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Give her the one-sixth!’

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, form Ali Bin Asbat, from Ismail Bin Mansour, from one of his companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When four grandmothers gather together, two from the direction of the mother, and two from the direction of the father, one is left out from the direction of the mother with the drawing of lots, so the one-sixth would be between the three. And similar to that, when four grandfathers are gathered together, one is dropped from the direction of the mother with the drawing of lots, and that the one-sixth would be between the three’.

citation.arabic_text: عِدَّةٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ أَسْبَاطٍ عَنْ إِسْمَاعِيلَ بْنِ مَنْصُورٍ عَنْ بَعْضِ أَصْحَابِهِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) قَالَ إِذَا اجْتَمَعَ أَرْبَعُ جَدَّاتٍ ثِنْتَيْنِ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْأُمِّ وَ ثِنْتَيْنِ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْأَبِ طُرِحَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْأُمِّ بِالْقُرْعَةِ فَكَانَ السُّدُسُ بَيْنَ الثَّلَاثَةِ وَ كَذَلِكَ إِذَا اجْتَمَعَ أَرْبَعَةُ أَجْدَادٍ أُسْقِطَ وَاحِدٌ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْأُمِّ بِالْقُرْعَةِ وَ كَانَ السُّدُسُ بَيْنَ الثَّلَاثَةِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, form Ali Bin Asbat, from Ismail Bin Mansour, from one of his companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When four grandmothers gather together, two from the direction of the mother, and two from the direction of the father, one is left out from the direction of the mother with the drawing of lots, so the one-sixth would be between the three. And similar to that, when four grandfathers are gathered together, one is dropped from the direction of the mother with the drawing of lots, and that the one-sixth would be between the three’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Ayoub, form Muhammad Bin Muslim who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> displayed a parchment, so the first of what faced me in it was a son of a brother (nephew) and a grandfather, then wealth (to be divided) between the two of them is two halves. So I said, ‘The judges with us are not judging with anything being for a son of the brother (nephew) with the grandfather’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This book is written by Ali<sup>asws</sup> and dictated by Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>’.

citation.arabic_text: نَشَرَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) صَحِيفَةً فَأَوَّلُ مَا تَلَقَّانِي فِيهَا ابْنُ أَخٍ وَ جَدٌّ الْمَالُ بَيْنَهُمَا نِصْفَانِ فَقُلْتُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاكَ إِنَّ الْقُضَاةَ عِنْدَنَا لَا يَقْضُونَ لِابْنِ الْأَخِ مَعَ الْجَدِّ بِشَيْ‏ءٍ فَقَالَ إِنَّ هَذَا الْكِتَابَ خَطُّ عَلِيٍّ ( عليه السلام ) وَ إِمْلَاءُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abu Ayoub, form Muhammad Bin Muslim who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> displayed a parchment, so the first of what faced me in it was a son of a brother (nephew) and a grandfather, then wealth (to be divided) between the two of them is two halves. So I said, ‘The judges with us are not judging with anything being for a son of the brother (nephew) with the grandfather’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘This book is written by Ali<sup>asws</sup> and dictated by Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (3/167)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Al Qasim Bin Suleyman, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abullah<sup>asws</sup> having said that Ali<sup>asws</sup> would make a son of the brother (nephew) inherit with the grandfather, the inheritance of his father’.

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ عَلِيّاً ( عليه السلام ) كَانَ يُوَرِّثُ ابْنَ الْأَخِ مَعَ الْجَدِّ مِيرَاثَ أَبِيهِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Al Qasim Bin Suleyman, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abullah<sup>asws</sup> having said that Ali<sup>asws</sup> would make a son of the brother (nephew) inherit with the grandfather, the inheritance of his father’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (23/168)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Jabir narrated to me<sup>asws</sup> from Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and he (Jabir) did not lie that a son of the brother (nephew) would be apportioned as the grandfather’.

citation.arabic_text: حَدَّثَنِي جَابِرٌ عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) وَ لَمْ يُكَذَّبْ [جَابِرٌ] أَنَّ ابْنَ الْأَخِ يُقَاسِمُ الْجَدَّ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘Jabir narrated to me<sup>asws</sup> from Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup>, and he (Jabir) did not lie that a son of the brother (nephew) would be apportioned as the grandfather’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (23/168)

text: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from Abu Shuayb, from Rafa’at, from Aban Bin Taghlib, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a son of a brother (nephew), with a grandfather. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The wealth is (divided) between the two of them, two halves’.

citation.arabic_text: رَوَى أَبُو شُعَيْبٍ عَنْ رِفَاعَةَ عَنْ أَبَانِ بْنِ تَغْلِبَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) قَالَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ ابْنِ أَخٍ وَ جَدٍّ فَقَالَ الْمَالُ بَيْنَهُمَا نِصْفَانِ .
citation.translation: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from Abu Shuayb, from Rafa’at, from Aban Bin Taghlib, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a son of a brother (nephew), with a grandfather. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The wealth is (divided) between the two of them, two halves’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (3/168)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazaz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said, ‘I looked at a parchment which Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> made me look at, so I read (what was) written in it, a son of a brother (nephew), and a grandfather, the wealth (to be divided) between the two of them, equally. So I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The ones in our presence are not judging by this judgement, nor are they making anything to be for a son of the brother’. So Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But, it was dictated by Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> from his<sup>saww</sup> mouth and written by Ali<sup>asws</sup>, by his<sup>asws</sup> hand’.

citation.arabic_text: نَظَرْتُ إِلَى صَحِيفَةٍ يَنْظُرُ فِيهَا أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) فَقَرَأْتُ فِيهَا مَكْتُوباً ابْنُ أَخٍ وَ جَدٌّ الْمَالُ بَيْنَهُمَا سَوَاءٌ فَقُلْتُ لِأَبِي جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) إِنَّ مَنْ عِنْدَنَا لَا يَقْضُونَ بِهَذَا الْقَضَاءِ وَ لَا يَجْعَلُونَ لِابْنِ الْأَخِ مَعَ الْجَدِّ شَيْئاً فَقَالَ أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) أَمَا إِنَّهُ إِمْلَاءُ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) وَ خَطُّ عَلِيٍّ ( عليه السلام ) مِنْ فِيهِ بِيَدِهِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Abu Ayoub Al Khazaz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said, ‘I looked at a parchment which Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> made me look at, so I read (what was) written in it, a son of a brother (nephew), and a grandfather, the wealth (to be divided) between the two of them, equally. So I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, ‘The ones in our presence are not judging by this judgement, nor are they making anything to be for a son of the brother’. So Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But, it was dictated by Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> from his<sup>saww</sup> mouth and written by Ali<sup>asws</sup>, by his<sup>asws</sup> hand’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (3/168)

text: Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazal Bin Shazaan, from Abdullah Bin Jabala, from Abu Al Magra, from Sama’at, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I heard a man asking Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, or Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, and I was in his<sup>asws</sup> presence, about a son of a brother (nephew), and a grandfather. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Make the wealth (to be divided) between the two of them, in two halves’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ رَجُلًا يَسْأَلُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) أَوْ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) وَ أَنَا عِنْدَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ أَخٍ وَ جَدٍّ قَالَ يُجْعَلُ الْمَالُ بَيْنَهُمَا نِصْفَيْنِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazal Bin Shazaan, from Abdullah Bin Jabala, from Abu Al Magra, from Sama’at, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I heard a man asking Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, or Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, and I was in his<sup>asws</sup> presence, about a son of a brother (nephew), and a grandfather. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Make the wealth (to be divided) between the two of them, in two halves’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول كالموثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (3/168)

text: Al Fazl, from Ibn Mahboub, from Sa’ad Bin Abu Khalaf, (It has been narrated) from one of the companions of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said regarding daughter of a sister, and a grandfather. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the daughters of the sister (nieces) is the one-third, and what remains is for the grandfather. So the daughters of the sister (nieces) stand in the place of the sister, and the grandfather is made to be at the status of the brother’.

citation.arabic_text: فِي بَنَاتِ أُخْتٍ وَ جَدٍّ فَقَالَ لِبَنَاتِ الْأُخْتِ الثُّلُثُ وَ مَا بَقِيَ فَلِلْجَدِّ فَأَقَامَ بَنَاتِ الْأُخْتِ مَقَامَ الْأُخْتِ وَ جَعَلَ الْجَدَّ بِمَنْزِلَةِ الْأَخِ .
citation.translation: Al Fazl, from Ibn Mahboub, from Sa’ad Bin Abu Khalaf, (It has been narrated) from one of the companions of Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said regarding daughter of a sister, and a grandfather. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the daughters of the sister (nieces) is the one-third, and what remains is for the grandfather. So the daughters of the sister (nieces) stand in the place of the sister, and the grandfather is made to be at the status of the brother’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (3/168)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, and a number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Al Hassan Bin Salih who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a woman whom her husband had yet to sleep with her, died, and left her mother, and her two brothers from her father and her mother (nephews), and her grandfather being father of her mother, and her husband. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the husband is the half, and give the remainder to the mother, and do not give anything to the grandfather, because his daughter blocks him from the inheritance, and the brothers would not be given anything (either)’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنِ امْرَأَةٍ مُمْلَكَةٍ لَمْ يَدْخُلْ بِهَا زَوْجُهَا مَاتَتْ وَ تَرَكَتْ أُمَّهَا وَ أَخَوَيْنِ لَهَا مِنْ أَبِيهَا وَ أُمِّهَا وَ جَدَّهَا أَبَا أُمِّهَا وَ زَوْجَهَا قَالَ يُعْطَى الزَّوْجُ النِّصْفَ وَ تُعْطَى الْأُمُّ الْبَاقِيَ وَ لَا يُعْطَى الْجَدُّ شَيْئاً لِأَنَّ ابْنَتَهُ حَجَبَتْهُ عَنِ الْمِيرَاثِ وَ لَا يُعْطَى الْإِخْوَةُ شَيْئاً .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, and a number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Al Hassan Bin Salih who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a woman whom her husband had yet to sleep with her, died, and left her mother, and her two brothers from her father and her mother (nephews), and her grandfather being father of her mother, and her husband. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the husband is the half, and give the remainder to the mother, and do not give anything to the grandfather, because his daughter blocks him from the inheritance, and the brothers would not be given anything (either)’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (3/169)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who died and left his father, and his uncle, and his grandfather. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The father blocks the grandfather. The inheritance is for the father and there is nothing for the uncle and the grandfather’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَ تَرَكَ أَبَاهُ وَ عَمَّهُ وَ جَدَّهُ قَالَ فَقَالَ حَجَبَ الْأَبُ الْجَدَّ الْمِيرَاثُ لِلْأَبِ وَ لَيْسَ لِلْعَمِّ وَ لَا لِلْجَدِّ شَيْ‏ءٌ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about a man who died and left his father, and his uncle, and his grandfather. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The father blocks the grandfather. The inheritance is for the father and there is nothing for the uncle and the grandfather’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (23/169)

text: And from him and Ali Bin Abdullah, both together from Ibrahim, from Abdullah Bin Ja’far who said, ‘I wrote to Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A woman died and left her husband, and her parent, or her grandfather, or her grandmother. How should her inheritance be distributed?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> signed: ‘For the husband is the half, and what remains, so it is for the two parents’. And it has also been reported as well that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the one-sixth for the grandfather and the grandmother’.

citation.arabic_text: كَتَبْتُ إِلَى أَبِي مُحَمَّدٍ ( عليه السلام ) امْرَأَةٌ مَاتَتْ وَ تَرَكَتْ زَوْجَهَا وَ أَبَوَيْهَا أَوْ جَدَّهَا أَوْ جَدَّتَهَا كَيْفَ يُقْسَمُ مِيرَاثُهَا فَوَقَّعَ ( عليه السلام ) لِلزَّوْجِ النِّصْفُ وَ مَا بَقِيَ فَلِلْأَبَوَيْنِ وَ قَدْ رُوِيَ أَيْضاً أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَطْعَمَ الْجَدَّ وَ الْجَدَّةَ السُّدُسَ .
citation.translation: And from him and Ali Bin Abdullah, both together from Ibrahim, from Abdullah Bin Ja’far who said, ‘I wrote to Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup>, ‘A woman died and left her husband, and her parent, or her grandfather, or her grandmother. And it has also been reported as well that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the one-sixth for the grandfather and the grandmother’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول وآخره مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (3/169)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said that: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the one-sixth for the grandmother’.

citation.arabic_text: إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَطْعَمَ الْجَدَّةَ السُّدُسَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said that: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the one-sixth for the grandmother’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (3/170)

text: From him, from Jameel Bin Darraj, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the grandmother, mother of the father, with the sixth, and her daughter was alive, and provided the grandmother, mother of the mother with the one-sixth, and her daughter was alive’.

citation.arabic_text: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَطْعَمَ الْجَدَّةَ أُمَّ الْأَبِ السُّدُسَ وَ ابْنُهَا حَيٌّ وَ أَطْعَمَ الْجَدَّةَ أُمَّ الْأُمِّ السُّدُسَ وَ ابْنَتُهَا حَيَّةٌ .
citation.translation: From him, from Jameel Bin Darraj, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the grandmother, mother of the father, with the sixth, and her daughter was alive, and provided the grandmother, mother of the mother with the one-sixth, and her daughter was alive’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (3/170)

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the grandmother with the one-sixth, and did not Obligate (legislate) anything for her’.

citation.arabic_text: أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَطْعَمَ الْجَدَّةَ السُّدُسَ وَ لَمْ يَفْرِضْ لَهَا شَيْئاً .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazal, from Ibn Bukeyr, from Zurara, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> that Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> provided the grandmother with the one-sixth, and did not Obligate (legislate) anything for her’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (23/170)

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazal, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Zurara who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> provided the grandmother with the one-sixth as a provision’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) يَقُولُ إِنَّ نَبِيَّ اللَّهِ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) أَطْعَمَ الْجَدَّةَ السُّدُسَ طُعْمَةً .
citation.translation: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazal, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Musa Bin Bakr, from Zurara who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘The Prophet<sup>saww</sup> of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> provided the grandmother with the one-sixth as a provision’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف على المشهور - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (3/170)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Sa’ad Bin Abu Khalaf, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Abdullah, said, ‘I came over to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and in his<sup>asws</sup> presence was Aban Bin Taghlub. So I said, ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Keep you well! My daughter died and my mother is alive’. So Aban said, ‘There is nothing for your mother’. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Glory be to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Give her the one-sixth!’

citation.arabic_text: دَخَلْتُ عَلَى أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) وَ عِنْدَهُ أَبَانُ بْنُ تَغْلِبَ فَقُلْتُ أَصْلَحَكَ اللَّهُ إِنَّ ابْنَتِي هَلَكَتْ وَ أُمِّي حَيَّةٌ فَقَالَ أَبَانٌ لَيْسَ لِأُمِّكَ شَيْ‏ءٌ فَقَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ أَعْطِهَا السُّدُسَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Sa’ad Bin Abu Khalaf, from Abdul Rahman Bin Abu Abdullah, said, ‘I came over to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> and in his<sup>asws</sup> presence was Aban Bin Taghlub. So I said, ‘May Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Keep you well! My daughter died and my mother is alive’. So Aban said, ‘There is nothing for your mother’. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Glory be to Allah<sup>azwj</sup>! Give her the one-sixth!’
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (23/171)

text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, form Ali Bin Asbat, from Ismail Bin Mansour, from one of his companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When four grandmothers gather together, two from the direction of the mother, and two from the direction of the father, one is left out from the direction of the mother with the drawing of lots, so the one-sixth would be between the three. And similar to that, when four grandfathers are gathered together, one is dropped from the direction of the mother with the drawing of lots, and that the one-sixth would be between the three’.

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا اجْتَمَعَ أَرْبَعُ جَدَّاتٍ ثِنْتَيْنِ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْأُمِّ وَ ثِنْتَيْنِ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْأَبِ طُرِحَتْ وَاحِدَةٌ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْأُمِّ بِالْقُرْعَةِ فَكَانَ السُّدُسُ بَيْنَ الثَّلَاثَةِ وَ كَذَلِكَ إِذَا اجْتَمَعَ أَرْبَعَةُ أَجْدَادٍ أُسْقِطَ وَاحِدٌ مِنْ قِبَلِ الْأُمِّ بِالْقُرْعَةِ وَ كَانَ السُّدُسُ بَيْنَ الثَّلَاثَةِ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, form Ali Bin Asbat, from Ismail Bin Mansour, from one of his companions, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘When four grandmothers gather together, two from the direction of the mother, and two from the direction of the father, one is left out from the direction of the mother with the drawing of lots, so the one-sixth would be between the three. And similar to that, when four grandfathers are gathered together, one is dropped from the direction of the mother with the drawing of lots, and that the one-sixth would be between the three’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (3/171)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad, all of them from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Ali Bin Raib, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about something from the Obligations (legislated shares of inheritance), so he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Shall I<sup>asws</sup> bring out for you a Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup>?’ So I<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘The Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup> is not studied’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Abu Muhammad! The Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup> is not studied?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> brought it out, and it was a splendid Book, and therein was, a man who died and left his paternal uncle and his maternal uncle. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the paternal uncle is two-thirds and for the maternal uncle is the one-third’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ شَيْ‏ءٍ مِنَ الْفَرَائِضِ فَقَالَ لِي أَ لَا أُخْرِجُ لَكَ كِتَابَ عَلِيٍّ ( عليه السلام ) فَقُلْتُ كِتَابُ عَلِيٍّ ( عليه السلام ) لَمْ يُدْرَسْ فَقَالَ يَا أَبَا مُحَمَّدٍ إِنَّ كِتَابَ عَلِيٍّ ( عليه السلام ) لَمْ يُدْرَسْ فَأَخْرَجَهُ فَإِذَا كِتَابٌ جَلِيلٌ وَ إِذَا فِيهِ رَجُلٌ مَاتَ وَ تَرَكَ عَمَّهُ وَ خَالَهُ قَالَ لِلْعَمِّ الثُّلُثَانِ وَ لِلْخَالِ الثُّلُثُ .
citation.translation: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad, all of them from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Ali Bin Raib, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about something from the Obligations (legislated shares of inheritance), so he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Shall I<sup>asws</sup> bring out for you a Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup>?’ So I<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘The Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup> is not studied’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘O Abu Muhammad! The Book of Ali<sup>asws</sup> is not studied?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> brought it out, and it was a splendid Book, and therein was, a man who died and left his paternal uncle and his maternal uncle. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the paternal uncle is two-thirds and for the maternal uncle is the one-third’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (23/176)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ynusu, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘The maternal uncle and the maternal aunt both inherit when there does not happen to be anyone with the two of them. Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [8:75] and the possessors of relationships are nearer to each other in the Book of Allah’.

citation.arabic_text: الْخَالُ وَ الْخَالَةُ يَرِثَانِ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُمَا أَحَدٌ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ يَقُولُ وَ أُولُوا الْأَرْحامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلى بِبَعْضٍ فِي كِتابِ اللَّهِ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ynusu, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘The maternal uncle and the maternal aunt both inherit when there does not happen to be anyone with the two of them. Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Saying [8:75] and the possessors of relationships are nearer to each other in the Book of Allah’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (3/177)

text: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from Wuheyb, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws, said, ‘I heard himasws saying: ‘The maternal uncle and the maternal aunt both inherit when there does not happen to be anyone apart from the two of them. Allahazwj Blessed and High is Saying [8:75] and the possessors of relationships are nearer to each other in the Book of Allah’.

citation.arabic_text: سَمِعْتُهُ يَقُولُ الْخَالُ وَ الْخَالَةُ يَرِثَانِ إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ مَعَهُمَا أَحَدٌ يَرِثُ غَيْرُهُمَا إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَكَ وَ تَعَالَى يَقُولُ وَ أُولُوا الْأَرْحامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلى بِبَعْضٍ فِي كِتابِ اللَّهِ .
citation.translation: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from Wuheyb, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws, said, ‘I heard himasws saying: ‘The maternal uncle and the maternal aunt both inherit when there does not happen to be anyone apart from the two of them. Allahazwj Blessed and High is Saying [8:75] and the possessors of relationships are nearer to each other in the Book of Allah’.

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Mohsin Bin Ahmad, from Aban, from Abu Maryam, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> regarding a paternal aunt and a maternal aunt. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one-third and the two thirds – meaning for the paternal aunt is two thirds and for the maternal aunt is the one-third’. Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad, from Al Masny, from Aban, from Abu Maryam, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, similar to it’.

citation.arabic_text: عَمَّةٍ وَ خَالَةٍ قَالَ الثُّلُثُ وَ الثُّلُثَانِ يَعْنِي لِلْعَمَّةِ الثُّلُثَانِ وَ لِلْخَالَةِ الثُّلُثُ . حُمَيْدُ بْنُ زِيَادٍ عَنِ الْحَسَنِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ الْمُثَنَّى عَنْ أَبَانٍ عَنْ أَبِي مَرْيَمَ عَنْ أَبِي جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) مِثْلَهُ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Mohsin Bin Ahmad, from Aban, from Abu Maryam, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> regarding a paternal aunt and a maternal aunt. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one-third and the two thirds – meaning for the paternal aunt is two thirds and for the maternal aunt is the one-third’. Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad, from Al Masny, from Aban, from Abu Maryam, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, similar to it’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مجهول - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (3/177)

text: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan, from Waheyb, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who left his paternal aunt and his maternal aunt. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the paternal aunt is the two-thirds and for the maternal aunt is the one-third’.

citation.arabic_text: رَجُلٍ تَرَكَ عَمَّتَهُ وَ خَالَتَهُ قَالَ لِلْعَمَّةِ الثُّلُثَانِ وَ لِلْخَالَةِ الثُّلُثُ .
citation.translation: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan, from Waheyb, from Abu Baseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who left his paternal aunt and his maternal aunt. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the paternal aunt is the two-thirds and for the maternal aunt is the one-third’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: موثق - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (3/178)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Hareyz, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said, ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the man who died and left his maternal uncle and his maternal aunt, and his paternal uncle and his paternal aunt, and his son, and his daughter, and his brother, and his sister. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘All of them would be inheriting and possessing. So when the paternal aunt and the maternal aunt gather together, so for the paternal aunt is the two thirds, and for the maternal aunt is the one-third’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) عَنِ الرَّجُلِ يَمُوتُ وَ يَتْرُكُ خَالَهُ وَ خَالَتَهُ وَ عَمَّهُ وَ عَمَّتَهُ وَ ابْنَهُ وَ ابْنَتَهُ وَ أَخَاهُ وَ أُخْتَهُ فَقَالَ كُلُّ هَؤُلَاءِ يَرِثُونَ وَ يَحُوزُونَ فَإِذَا اجْتَمَعَتِ الْعَمَّةُ وَ الْخَالَةُ فَلِلْعَمَّةِ الثُّلُثَانِ وَ لِلْخَالَةِ الثُّلُثُ .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sahl, from Al Husayn Bin Al Hakam, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws the 2nd regarding a man who died and left his two maternal aunts and his adherents. Heasws said: ‘[8:75] and the possessors of relationships are nearer to each other – the wealth is between the two maternal aunts’.

citation.arabic_text: رَجُلٍ مَاتَ وَ تَرَكَ خَالَتَيْهِ وَ مَوَالِيَهُ قَالَ أُولُوا الْأَرْحَامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلَى بِبَعْضٍ الْمَالُ بَيْنَ الْخَالَتَيْنِ .
citation.translation: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Muhammad Bin Sahl, from Al Husayn Bin Al Hakam, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws the 2nd regarding a man who died and left his two maternal aunts and his adherents. Heasws said: ‘[8:75] and the possessors of relationships are nearer to each other – the wealth is between the two maternal aunts’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (23/178)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Dorost Bin Abu Mansour, from Abu Al Magra, from a man, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘A person perished (died) and left his paternal aunt and his maternal aunt, so for the paternal aunt are two-thirds, and for the maternal aunt is the one-third’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ إِنِ امْرُؤٌ هَلَكَ وَ تَرَكَ عَمَّتَهُ وَ خَالَتَهُ فَلِلْعَمَّةِ الثُّلُثَانِ وَ لِلْخَالَةِ الثُّلُثُ .

text: And the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> has said: ‘The maternal uncle is an inheritor of the one who has not (other) inheritor for him’.

citation.arabic_text: وَ قَدْ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ ( صلى الله عليه وآله ) الْخَالُ وَارِثُ مَنْ لَا وَارِثَ لَهُ .
citation.translation: And the Prophet<sup>saww</sup> has said: ‘The maternal uncle is an inheritor of the one who has not (other) inheritor for him’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: ضعيف - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (23/179)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Najran and Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, altogether from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Muhammad Bin Qays, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws regarding the woman who passed away and no one was known to be for her, and for her was a husband. Heasws said: ‘The inheritance, all of it, is for her husband’[360]. From him, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Yahya al Halby, from Ayoub Bin Al Hurr, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I was in the presence of Abu Abdullahasws, so heasws called for Al-Jami’a (Book of Aliasws). So we looked into it, and therein was, a woman who died and left her husband, not having an inheritor for her other than him, for him was the wealth, all of it’.

citation.arabic_text: امْرَأَةٍ تُوُفِّيَتْ وَ لَمْ يُعْلَمْ لَهَا أَحَدٌ وَ لَهَا زَوْجٌ قَالَ الْمِيرَاثُ كُلُّهُ لِزَوْجِهَا . عَنْهُ عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ يُونُسَ عَنْ يَحْيَى الْحَلَبِيِّ عَنْ أَيُّوبَ بْنِ الْحُرِّ عَنْ أَبِي بَصِيرٍ قَالَ كُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) فَدَعَا بِالْجَامِعَةِ فَنَظَرْنَا فِيهَا فَإِذَا فِيهَا امْرَأَةٌ هَلَكَتْ وَ تَرَكَتْ زَوْجَهَا لَا وَارِثَ لَهَا غَيْرُهُ لَهُ الْمَالُ كُلُّهُ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Najran and Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, altogether from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Muhammad Bin Qays, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws regarding the woman who passed away and no one was known to be for her, and for her was a husband. Heasws said: ‘The inheritance, all of it, is for her husband’[360]. From him, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Yahya al Halby, from Ayoub Bin Al Hurr, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I was in the presence of Abu Abdullahasws, so heasws called for Al-Jami’a (Book of Aliasws). So we looked into it, and therein was, a woman who died and left her husband, not having an inheritor for her other than him, for him was the wealth, all of it’.

So I wrote to Al-Abd Al-Salih<sup>asws</sup> (7<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>). So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote to me: ‘Give the woman the one-quarter, and carry the remainder to us<sup>asws</sup>’.

citation.arabic_text: مَاتَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ بَيَّاعُ السَّابِرِيِّ وَ أَوْصَى إِلَيَّ وَ تَرَكَ امْرَأَةً لَهُ وَ لَمْ يَتْرُكْ وَارِثاً غَيْرَهَا فَكَتَبْتُ إِلَى الْعَبْدِ الصَّالِحِ ( عليه السلام ) فَكَتَبَ إِلَيَّ أَعْطِ الْمَرْأَةَ الرُّبُعَ وَ احْمِلِ الْبَاقِيَ إِلَيْنَا .

text: From him, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Bin Rabat, from Muhammad Bin Sukeyn and Ali Bin Abu Hamza, from Mushmail, and from Ibn Rabat, from Mushmail, all of them from Abu Baseer who said, ‘Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> read out to me regarding the Obligations (legislated shares of inheritance), a woman who passed away and left her husband. And (about a man who died and left his wife (only), he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘For the wife is the one-quarter and whatever remains, so it is for the Imam<sup>asws</sup>’.

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, altogether, from Ali Bin Mahziyar who said, ‘Muhammad Bin Hamza Al-Alawy wrote to Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> the 2<sup>nd</sup>., ‘A friend of yours<sup>asws</sup> bequeathed to me with one hundred Dirhams, and I heard him saying, ‘Everything which is for me, so it is from my Master’. So he died and left it, and did not instruct anything with regards to it, and for him are two wives. As for one of them, so she is at Baghdad and I do not know of her whereabout at this time, and the other one is at Qum. So what is that which you<sup>asws</sup> are instructing me with regards to this one hundred Dirhams?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote to him: ‘Look around to hand over from these Dirhams to the two wives of the man, and both their rights from that is the one-eighth, if there was a child for him. So if there was not child for him, so the quarter, and give in charity with the remainder upon the one whom you recognise that he is needy for it, Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Willing’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Ibn Azina, from Zurara, and Bukeyr, and Fuzayl, and Bureyd, and Muhammad Bin Muslim, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> and Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, among them being ones who reported from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, and among them being ones who reported from one of the two<sup>asws</sup>, that: ‘The woman does not inherit from the legacy of her husband, from the dust of the house (land value), or land, except that the bricks and the wood would be valued, so she would be given her quarter, or her eighth if there was a child for her, from the value of the bricks, and the timber, and the canes’.

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Al A’ala, from Muhammad Bin Muslim who said, ‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The woman (widow) does inherit from the bricks and does not inherit anything from the land’. I said, ‘How comes she inherits from the branches and does not inherit anything from the roots?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘There is no lineage for her from them to inherit by. But rather, she has entered (from being an outsider) upon them, so she inherits from the branches and does not inherit from the roots, and an outsider is not to be included upon them by the cause of it’.

citation.arabic_text: قَالَ أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) تَرِثُ الْمَرْأَةُ مِنَ الطُّوبِ وَ لَا تَرِثُ مِنَ الرِّبَاعِ شَيْئاً قَالَ قُلْتُ كَيْفَ تَرِثُ مِنَ الْفَرْعِ وَ لَا تَرِثُ مِنَ الْأَصْلِ شَيْئاً فَقَالَ لِي لَيْسَ لَهَا مِنْهُمْ نَسَبٌ تَرِثُ بِهِ وَ إِنَّمَا هِيَ دَخِيلٌ عَلَيْهِمْ فَتَرِثُ مِنَ الْفَرْعِ وَ لَا تَرِثُ مِنَ الْأَصْلِ وَ لَا يَدْخُلُ عَلَيْهِمْ دَاخِلٌ بِسَبَبِهَا .

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazal Bin Shazaan, altogether from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> asked me: ‘Has Ibn Abu Layli ever judged with a judgement, then retracted from it?’ So I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘It has reached me that he judged with regards to the chattels (possessions) of the man and the woman, when one of the two had died, so the inheritors of the alive and the inheritors of the deceased claimed it, or the man divorced her, so the man claimed it and the women claimed it. He judged with four judgements’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And what was that?’ So I said, ‘As for the first one of these, so he judged in it by the worlds of Ibrahim Al-Nakhai’e who had made the possessions of the woman which were not correct for the men, to be for the women, and the chattels of the man which were not correct for the women, to be for the men, and whatever was for the men and the women, (to be divided) between the two of them in two halves. Then it reached me that he said, ‘They are both together claimants, so that which is their hands entirely, (to be divided) between the two of them by two halves’. Then he said, ‘The man is the owner of the house, and the woman is the coming upon him as an outsider, and she is the claimant, so the chattels, all of them are for the man except for the chattels of the woman which cannot happen to be for the men, so these are for the woman’. Then he judged after that with such a judgement, had I not witnessed it, I would not have referred it to him. A woman from us died, and for her was her husband, and she left chattels. So we raised the matter to him, so he said, ‘Write down the (list of) chattels’. So when he read it, he said to the husband, ‘This which happens to be for the man and the woman, so we make it to be for the woman, except for the scale, for it is from a chattels of the man, so it is for you’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘So upon which thing is he on today?’ I said, ‘He has reverted to what was said by the words of Ibrahim Al-Nakhai’e that the house is to be made to be for the man’. Then I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about that, so I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What are you<sup>asws</sup> saying with regards to it?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The words which you informed me<sup>asws</sup> that you witnessed it, even though he had reverted from it’. So I said, ‘The chattels (possessons) happen to be for the woman?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘What is your view that if she had to establish proof, how much would she need to?’ So I said, ‘Two witnesses’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If you were to ask the ones between the two mountains, and we are today at Makkah, they would tell you that the baggage and the chattels which were gifted openly from the house of the woman to the house of her husband, so these are which she came with, and if he were to claim, so if he claims that he has renewed any of these, so it is upon him to establish the proof’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلَنِي هَلْ يَقْضِي ابْنُ أَبِي لَيْلَى بِالْقَضَاءِ ثُمَّ يَرْجِعُ عَنْهُ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّهُ قَضَى فِي مَتَاعِ الرَّجُلِ وَ الْمَرْأَةِ إِذْ مَاتَ أَحَدُهُمَا فَادَّعَاهُ وَرَثَةُ الْحَيِّ وَ وَرَثَةُ الْمَيِّتِ أَوْ طَلَّقَهَا الرَّجُلُ فَادَّعَاهُ الرَّجُلُ وَ ادَّعَتْهُ النِّسَاءُ بِأَرْبَعِ قَضِيَّاتٍ فَقَالَ وَ مَا ذَاكَ فَقُلْتُ أَمَّا أُولَيهُنَّ فَقَضَى فِيهِ بِقَوْلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ النَّخَعِيِّ كَانَ يَجْعَلُ مَتَاعَ الْمَرْأَةِ الَّتِي لَا يَصْلُحُ لِلرِّجَالِ لِلْمَرْأَةِ وَ مَتَاعَ الرَّجُلِ الَّذِي لَا يَصْلُحُ لِلنِّسَاءِ لِلرَّجُلِ وَ مَا كَانَ لِلرِّجَالِ وَ النِّسَاءِ بَيْنَهُمَا نِصْفَانِ ثُمَّ بَلَغَنِي أَنَّهُ قَالَ إِنَّهُمَا مُدَّعِيَانِ جَمِيعاً فَالَّذِي بِأَيْدِيهِمَا جَمِيعاً بَيْنَهُمَا نِصْفَانِ ثُمَّ قَالَ الرِّجَالُ صَاحِبُ الْبَيْتِ وَ الْمَرْأَةُ الدَّاخِلَةُ عَلَيْهِ وَ هِيَ الْمُدَّعِيَةُ فَالْمَتَاعُ كُلُّهُ لِلرَّجُلِ إِلَّا مَتَاعَ النِّسَاءِ الَّذِي لَا يَكُونُ لِلرِّجَالِ فَهُوَ لِلْمَرْأَةِ ثُمَّ قَضَى بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ بِقَضَاءٍ لَوْ لَا أَنِّي شَاهَدْتُهُ لَمْ أَرُدَّهُ عَلَيْهِ مَاتَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنَّا وَ لَهَا زَوْجُهَا وَ تَرَكَتْ مَتَاعاً فَرَفَعْتُهُ إِلَيْهِ فَقَالَ اكْتُبُوا الْمَتَاعَ فَلَمَّا قَرَأَهُ قَالَ لِلزَّوْجِ هَذَا يَكُونُ لِلرَّجُلِ وَ الْمَرْأَةِ فَقَدْ جَعَلْنَاهُ لِلْمَرْأَةِ إِلَّا الْمِيزَانَ فَإِنَّهُ مِنْ مَتَاعِ الرَّجُلِ فَهُوَ لَكَ فَقَالَ لِي فَعَلَى أَيِّ شَيْ‏ءٍ هُوَ الْيَوْمَ قُلْتُ رَجَعَ إِلَى أَنْ قَالَ بِقَوْلِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ النَّخَعِيِّ أَنْ جَعَلَ الْبَيْتَ لِلرَّجُلِ ثُمَّ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ ذَلِكَ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ مَا تَقُولُ أَنْتَ فِيهِ فَقَالَ الْقَوْلَ الَّذِي أَخْبَرْتَنِي أَنَّكَ شَهِدْتَهُ وَ إِنْ كَانَ قَدْ رَجَعَ عَنْهُ فَقُلْتُ يَكُونُ الْمَتَاعُ لِلْمَرْأَةِ فَقَالَ أَ رَأَيْتَ إِنْ أَقَامَتْ بَيِّنَةً إِلَى كَمْ كَانَتْ تَحْتَاجُ فَقُلْتُ شَاهِدَيْنِ فَقَالَ لَوْ سَأَلْتَ مَنْ بَيْنَهُمَا يَعْنِي الْجَبَلَيْنِ وَ نَحْنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ بِمَكَّةَ لَأَخْبَرُوكَ أَنَّ الْجَهَازَ وَ الْمَتَاعَ يُهْدَى عَلَانِيَةً مِنْ بَيْتِ الْمَرْأَةِ إِلَى بَيْتِ زَوْجِهَا فَهِيَ الَّتِي جَاءَتْ بِهِ وَ هَذَا الْمُدَّعِي فَإِنْ زَعَمَ أَنَّهُ أَحْدَثَ فِيهِ شَيْئاً فَلْيَأْتِ عَلَيْهِ الْبَيِّنَةَ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazal Bin Shazaan, altogether from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘He<sup>asws</sup> asked me: ‘Has Ibn Abu Layli ever judged with a judgement, then retracted from it?’ So I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘It has reached me that he judged with regards to the chattels (possessions) of the man and the woman, when one of the two had died, so the inheritors of the alive and the inheritors of the deceased claimed it, or the man divorced her, so the man claimed it and the women claimed it. He judged with four judgements’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And what was that?’ So I said, ‘As for the first one of these, so he judged in it by the worlds of Ibrahim Al-Nakhai’e who had made the possessions of the woman which were not correct for the men, to be for the women, and the chattels of the man which were not correct for the women, to be for the men, and whatever was for the men and the women, (to be divided) between the two of them in two halves. Then it reached me that he said, ‘They are both together claimants, so that which is their hands entirely, (to be divided) between the two of them by two halves’. Then he said, ‘The man is the owner of the house, and the woman is the coming upon him as an outsider, and she is the claimant, so the chattels, all of them are for the man except for the chattels of the woman which cannot happen to be for the men, so these are for the woman’. Then he judged after that with such a judgement, had I not witnessed it, I would not have referred it to him. A woman from us died, and for her was her husband, and she left chattels. So we raised the matter to him, so he said, ‘Write down the (list of) chattels’. So when he read it, he said to the husband, ‘This which happens to be for the man and the woman, so we make it to be for the woman, except for the scale, for it is from a chattels of the man, so it is for you’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘So upon which thing is he on today?’ I said, ‘He has reverted to what was said by the words of Ibrahim Al-Nakhai’e that the house is to be made to be for the man’. Then I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about that, so I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘What are you<sup>asws</sup> saying with regards to it?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The words which you informed me<sup>asws</sup> that you witnessed it, even though he had reverted from it’. So I said, ‘The chattels (possessons) happen to be for the woman?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said, ‘What is your view that if she had to establish proof, how much would she need to?’ So I said, ‘Two witnesses’. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If you were to ask the ones between the two mountains, and we are today at Makkah, they would tell you that the baggage and the chattels which were gifted openly from the house of the woman to the house of her husband, so these are which she came with, and if he were to claim, so if he claims that he has renewed any of these, so it is upon him to establish the proof’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن كالصحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (23/191)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Ibn Raib, from Abu Baseer who said, ‘I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> about a man who married four women in one contract, or I said, in one gathering, their dowries being different. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is allowed for him and for them’. I said, ‘What is your<sup>asws</sup> view if he goes out to one of the cities, so he divorces one of the four, and a group from that city bear witness to his divorce, and they do not know the woman. Then he married a woman from the people of that city, after the passing of the waiting period of that divorced woman. Then he dies after that, after having gone to bed with her. How should his inheritance be distributed?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If there were children for him, so the woman whom he married at the end, from the people of that city is a quarter of the eight of what is left (as legacy). And if the woman who had been divorced from the four is recognised by sight and her lineage, so there is nothing for her from the inheritance, and upon her is the waiting period’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘And the three woman would divide the three-fourth of the (remaining) one-eighth of what is left, and upon them is the waiting period. And if the one from the four who had been divorced is not recognised, she would be apportion as the four women’, three-fourth of the one-eighth of what is left, between them all, and upon them all is the waiting period’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ رَجُلٍ تَزَوَّجَ أَرْبَعَ نِسْوَةٍ فِي عَقْدَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ أَوْ قَالَ فِي مَجْلِسٍ وَاحِدٍ وَ مُهُورُهُنَّ مُخْتَلِفَةٌ قَالَ جَائِزٌ لَهُ وَ لَهُنَّ قُلْتُ أَ رَأَيْتَ إِنْ هُوَ خَرَجَ إِلَى بَعْضِ الْبُلْدَانِ فَطَلَّقَ وَاحِدَةً مِنَ الْأَرْبَعِ وَ أَشْهَدَ عَلَى طَلَاقِهَا قَوْماً مِنْ أَهْلِ تِلْكَ الْبِلَادِ وَ هُمْ لَا يَعْرِفُونَ الْمَرْأَةَ ثُمَّ تَزَوَّجَ امْرَأَةً مِنْ أَهْلِ تِلْكَ الْبِلَادِ بَعْدَ انْقِضَاءِ عِدَّةِ تِلْكَ الْمُطَلَّقَةِ ثُمَّ مَاتَ بَعْدَ مَا دَخَلَ بِهَا كَيْفَ يُقْسَمُ مِيرَاثُهُ قَالَ إِنْ كَانَ لَهُ وَلَدٌ فَإِنَّ لِلْمَرْأَةِ الَّتِي تَزَوَّجَهَا أَخِيراً مِنْ أَهْلِ تِلْكَ الْبِلَادِ رُبُعَ ثُمُنِ مَا تَرَكَ وَ إِنْ عُرِفَتِ الَّتِي طُلِّقَتْ مِنَ الْأَرْبَعِ بِعَيْنِهَا وَ نَسَبِهَا فَلَا شَيْ‏ءَ لَهَا مِنَ الْمِيرَاثِ وَ عَلَيْهَا الْعِدَّةُ قَالَ وَ يَقْسِمْنَ الثَّلَاثُ نِسْوَةٍ ثَلَاثَةَ أَرْبَاعِ ثُمُنِ مَا تَرَكَ وَ عَلَيْهِنَّ الْعِدَّةُ وَ إِنْ لَمْ تُعْرَفِ الَّتِي طُلِّقَتْ مِنَ الْأَرْبَعِ اقْتَسَمْنَ الْأَرْبَعُ نِسْوَةٍ ثَلَاثَةَ أَرْبَاعِ ثُمُنِ مَا تَرَكَ بَيْنَهُنَّ جَمِيعاً وَ عَلَيْهِنَّ جَمِيعاً الْعِدَّةُ .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Naeem Bin Ibrahim, from Abbad Bin Kaseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who got his mature son married to an orphan girls in his custody. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She would inherit him if he dies, and he would not inherit her because for her there is the choice (to get married again), and there is no choice against her’.

citation.arabic_text: عِدَّةٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ سَهْلِ بْنِ زِيَادٍ عَنِ ابْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ وَ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنِ ابْنِ مَحْبُوبٍ عَنْ نُعَيْمِ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ عَبَّادِ بْنِ كَثِيرٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) قَالَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ زَوَّجَ ابْناً لَهُ مُدْرِكاً مِنْ يَتِيمَةٍ فِي حَجْرِهِ قَالَ تَرِثُهُ إِنْ مَاتَ وَ لَا يَرِثُهَا لِأَنَّ لَهَا الْخِيَارَ وَ لَا خِيَارَ عَلَيْهَا .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazal, from Al Qasim Bin Urwa, from Ibn Bakeyr, from Ubeyd Bin Zurara, The narrator says: ‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the young boy who marries the young girl (both immature), would they both be inheriting?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If their fathers who were the ones who arranged their marriage, then yes’. I said, ‘Is the divorce by the father permissible?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.

citation.arabic_text: مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يَحْيَى عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَنِ ابْنِ فَضَّالٍ عَنِ الْقَاسِمِ بْنِ عُرْوَةَ عَنِ ابْنِ بُكَيْرٍ عَنْ عُبَيْدِ بْنِ زُرَارَةَ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) قَالَ سَأَلْتُهُ عَنِ الصَّبِيِّ يُزَوَّجُ الصَّبِيَّةَ هَلْ يَتَوَارَثَانِ قَالَ إِذَا كَانَ أَبَوَاهُمَا [هُمَا] اللَّذَانِ زَوَّجَاهُمَا فَنَعَمْ قُلْتُ أَ يَجُوزُ طَلَاقُ الْأَبِ قَالَ لَا .

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Ali Bin Raib, from Abu Ubeyda who said, ‘I asked Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> about a boy and a girls, their guardians got them married, and they were both not matured yet. So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The marriage is allowed, and whichever of the two matures, the choice would be for him. So if he were to die before he matures, so there would not be any inheritance between the two of them, nor any dowry except if they had matured and were happy (with the marriage)’. I said, ‘So if one of the two were to mature before the other?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘That is allowed upon him if he was happy (with the marriage)’. I said, ‘So if the man were to mature before the girl and he was happy with the marriage, then he dies before the girl having matured, would she inherit him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Yes. Her inheritance would be isolated from him until she matures, and she would have to swear by Allah<sup>azwj</sup> that she is not claiming to take the inheritance except that she was happy with the marriage, then the inheritance would be handed over to her, and half of the dower’. I said, ‘So if she the girl dies and not having matured, would the mature husband inherit her?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No, because for her was a choice when she matured’. I said, ‘So if it was her father who had got her married before she had matured?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The marriage by her father is allowed upon her, and it is allowed upon the boy, and the dower is (due) upon the father of the girl’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُ أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ ( عليه السلام ) عَنْ غُلَامٍ وَ جَارِيَةٍ زَوَّجَهُمَا وَلِيَّانِ لَهُمَا وَ هُمَا غَيْرُ مُدْرِكَيْنِ قَالَ فَقَالَ النِّكَاحُ جَائِزٌ وَ أَيُّهُمَا أَدْرَكَ كَانَ لَهُ الْخِيَارُ فَإِنْ مَاتَا قَبْلَ أَنْ يُدْرِكَا فَلَا مِيرَاثَ بَيْنَهُمَا وَ لَا مَهْرَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَا قَدْ أَدْرَكَا وَ رَضِيَا قُلْتُ فَإِنْ أَدْرَكَ أَحَدُهُمَا قَبْلَ الْآخَرِ قَالَ يَجُوزُ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ إِنْ هُوَ رَضِيَ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ كَانَ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي أَدْرَكَ قَبْلَ الْجَارِيَةَ وَ رَضِيَ بِالنِّكَاحِ ثُمَّ مَاتَ قَبْلَ أَنْ تُدْرِكَ الْجَارِيَةُ أَ تَرِثُهُ قَالَ نَعَمْ يُعْزَلُ مِيرَاثُهَا مِنْهُ حَتَّى تُدْرِكَ وَ تَحْلِفَ بِاللَّهِ مَا ادَّعَاهَا إِلَى أَخْذِ الْمِيرَاثِ إِلَّا رِضَاهَا بِالتَّزْوِيجِ ثُمَّ يُدْفَعُ إِلَيْهَا الْمِيرَاثُ وَ نِصْفُ الْمَهْرِ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ مَاتَتِ الْجَارِيَةُ وَ لَمْ تَكُنْ أَدْرَكَتْ أَ يَرِثُهَا الزَّوْجُ الْمُدْرِكُ قَالَ لَا لِأَنَّ لَهَا الْخِيَارَ إِذَا أَدْرَكَتْ قُلْتُ فَإِنْ كَانَ أَبُوهَا هُوَ الَّذِي زَوَّجَهَا قَبْلَ أَنْ تُدْرِكَ قَالَ يَجُوزُ عَلَيْهَا تَزْوِيجُ الْأَبِ وَ يَجُوزُ عَلَى الْغُلَامِ وَ الْمَهْرُ عَلَى الْأَبِ لِلْجَارِيَةِ .

I said, ‘So if it was her father who had got her married before she had matured?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The marriage by her father is allowed upon her, and it is allowed upon the boy, and the dower is (due) upon the father of the girl’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: صحيح - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (23/194)

text: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Ibn Mahboub and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ibn Mahboub, from Naeem Bin Ibrahim, from Abbad Bin Kaseer, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said, ‘I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who got his mature son married to an orphan girls in his custody. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She would inherit him if he dies, and he would not inherit her because for her there is the choice (to get married again), and there is no choice against her’.

citation.arabic_text: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ رَجُلٍ زَوَّجَ ابْناً لَهُ مُدْرِكاً مِنْ يَتِيمَةٍ فِي حَجْرِهِ قَالَ تَرِثُهُ إِنْ مَاتَ وَ لَا يَرِثُهَا لِأَنَّ لَهَا الْخِيَارَ وَ لَا خِيَارَ عَلَيْهَا .

I said, ‘Is the divorce by the father permissible?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘No’.

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Abu Al Abbas, Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘When the man divorces the woman during his illness, she inherits him for as long as he is in that illness even if she has fulfilled her waiting period, except if he were to become healthy from it’. So I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘So if the illness prolongs with him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What is between it and a year’.

citation.arabic_text: عَلِيُّ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ عَنْ أَبِيهِ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي عُمَيْرٍ عَنْ جَمِيلِ بْنِ دَرَّاجٍ عَنْ أَبِي الْعَبَّاسِ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) قَالَ إِذَا طَلَّقَ الرَّجُلُ الْمَرْأَةَ فِي مَرَضِهِ وَرِثَتْهُ مَا دَامَ فِي مَرَضِهِ ذَلِكَ وَ إِنِ انْقَضَتْ عِدَّتُهَا إِلَّا أَنْ يَصِحَّ مِنْهُ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ فَإِنْ طَالَ بِهِ الْمَرَضُ قَالَ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ سَنَةٍ .

So I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘So if the illness prolongs with him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What is between it and a year’.

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from one of our companions, from Aban Bin Usman, from Al Halby and Abu baser and Abu Al Abbas, altogether, Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘She would inherit him and he would not inherit her when the waiting period is fulfilled’.

citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from one of our companions, from Aban Bin Usman, from Al Halby and Abu baser and Abu Al Abbas, altogether, Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘She would inherit him and he would not inherit her when the waiting period is fulfilled’.

text: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Aban, from a man, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who divorces his wife with two divorces during correctness (well being). Then he divorces the third times and he is ill. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She would inherit him for as long as he is in his illness, and even though it may be up to a year’.

citation.arabic_text: رَجُلٍ طَلَّقَ امْرَأَتَهُ تَطْلِيقَتَيْنِ فِي صِحَّةٍ ثُمَّ طَلَّقَ الثَّالِثَةَ وَ هُوَ مَرِيضٌ قَالَ تَرِثُهُ مَا دَامَ فِي مَرَضِهِ وَ إِنْ كَانَ إِلَى سَنَةٍ .
citation.translation: Ali, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Aban, from a man, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding a man who divorces his wife with two divorces during correctness (well being). Then he divorces the third times and he is ill. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘She would inherit him for as long as he is in his illness, and even though it may be up to a year’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: مرسل - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (23/198)

text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Abu Al Abbas, Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘When the man divorces the woman during his illness, she inherits him for as long as he is in that illness even if she has fulfilled her waiting period, except if he were to become healthy from it’. So I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘So if the illness prolongs with him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What is between it and a year’.

citation.arabic_text: إِذَا طَلَّقَ الرَّجُلُ الْمَرْأَةَ فِي مَرَضِهِ وَرِثَتْهُ مَا دَامَ فِي مَرَضِهِ ذَلِكَ وَ إِنِ انْقَضَتْ عِدَّتُهَا إِلَّا أَنْ يَصِحَّ مِنْهُ فَقُلْتُ لَهُ فَإِنْ طَالَ بِهِ الْمَرَضُ قَالَ مَا بَيْنَهُ وَ بَيْنَ سَنَةٍ .
citation.translation: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Jameel Bin Darraj, from Abu Al Abbas, Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘When the man divorces the woman during his illness, she inherits him for as long as he is in that illness even if she has fulfilled her waiting period, except if he were to become healthy from it’. So I said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘So if the illness prolongs with him?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘What is between it and a year’.
citation.grade_source: Allamah Baqir al-Majlisi: حسن - Mir‘at al ‘Uqul Fi Sharh Akhbar Al al Rasul (3/198)

text: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from one of our companions, from Aban Bin Usman, from Al Halby and Abu baser and Abu Al Abbas, altogether, Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘She would inherit him and he would not inherit her when the waiting period is fulfilled’.

citation.arabic_text: تَرِثُهُ وَ لَا يَرِثُهَا إِذَا انْقَضَتِ الْعِدَّةُ .
citation.translation: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moala Bin Muhammad, from one of our companions, from Aban Bin Usman, from Al Halby and Abu baser and Abu Al Abbas, altogether, Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘She would inherit him and he would not inherit her when the waiting period is fulfilled’.

text: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, together from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj, from the one who narrated it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the sick man who divorces his wife during illness’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘If he dies in that illness of his, and she is residing with him and has not re-married, she would inherit him, and if she has re-married, so she is happy with that which has been done, and then there is no inheritance for her’.

citation.translation: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from Muhammad Bin Abdul Jabbar and Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, together from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Abdul Rahman Bin Al Hajjaj, from the one who narrated it, (It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> regarding the sick man who divorces his wife during illness’. text: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abu Sabit, from hanan, from Ibn Abu Yafour, from Is’haq Bin Ammar, Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘A slave of Ali<sup>asws</sup> Bin Al-Husayn<sup>asws</sup> died, so he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Look around, can you find an inheritor for him?’ So it was said to him<sup>asws</sup>, ‘There are two daughters of his at Yamama, both slaves’. So he<sup>asws</sup> bought them both from the wealth of the dead slave, then handed over the rest to them both’.

citation.arabic_text: عِدَّةٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِنَا عَنْ أَحْمَدَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى عَنْ أَبِي ثَابِتٍ عَنْ حَنَانٍ عَنِ ابْنِ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ عَنْ إِسْحَاقَ بْنِ عَمَّارٍ عَنْ أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) قَالَ مَاتَ مَوْلًى لِعَلِيِّ بْنِ الْحُسَيْنِ ( عليه السلام ) فَقَالَ انْظُرُوا هَلْ تَجِدُونَ لَهُ وَارِثاً فَقِيلَ لَهُ ابْنَتَانِ بِالْيَمَامَةِ مَمْلُوكَتَانِ فَاشْتَرَاهُمَا مِنْ مَالِ مَوْلَاهُ الْمَيِّتِ ثُمَّ دَفَعَ إِلَيْهِمَا بَقِيَّةَ الْمَالِ .

text: Muhammad Bin Ismail, from Al Fazl Bin Shazaan, from Abu Sabit, from hanan Bin Sudeyr, from Ibn Abu Yafour, from Is’haq who said, ‘A slave of Aliasws Bin Al-Husaynasws died. text: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Najran, from Aasim Bin Humeyd, from Muhammad Bin Qays, (It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’farasws having said: ‘Amir Al-Momineenasws judged regarding a maternal aunt who came disputing regarding the slave of a man who had died. So heasws read this Verse [33:6] and the possessors of relationships some of them are closer to others in the Book of Allah – so heasws handed over the inheritance to the maternal aunt and did not give it to the master’.

citation.arabic_text: قَضَى أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ ( عليه السلام ) فِي خَالَةٍ جَاءَتْ تُخَاصِمُ فِي مَوْلَى رَجُلٍ مَاتَ فَقَرَأَ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ وَ أُولُوا الْأَرْحامِ بَعْضُهُمْ أَوْلى بِبَعْضٍ فِي كِتابِ اللَّهِ فَدَفَعَ الْمِيرَاثَ إِلَى الْخَالَةِ وَ لَمْ يُعْطِ الْمَوْلَى .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya and others, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Al Jaham, from Hanan who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullahasws, ‘Which thing is for the Mawla (Master)?’ So heasws said: ‘There is nothing for them from the inheritance except what Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic has Said [33:6] except that you should do good to your guardians’.

citation.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِأَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ ( عليه السلام ) أَيُّ شَيْ‏ءٍ لِلْمَوَالِي فَقَالَ لَيْسَ لَهُمْ مِنَ الْمِيرَاثِ إِلَّا مَا قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ إِلَّا أَنْ تَفْعَلُوا إِلى أَوْلِيائِكُمْ مَعْرُوفاً .

text: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ibn Fazal, from Ibn Abu Al Hamra’a who said, ‘I said to Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, ‘Which thing from the inheritance, is for the Mawla (Master)?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘There is nothing for them except for the soil, meaning dust’.

text: Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hassan Al Taymi, from Muhammad Bin Tasneem the scribe, from Abdul Rahman Bin Amro, and from Muhammad Bin Sinan, from Amro Al Azraq who said, ‘I heard Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> saying, and a man asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who died and left a daughter of his sister, and left slaves, and for him, with me are a thousand Dirhams, and no one knows about it. So the daughter of his sister came over and she kept parchments with me as security, so I gave her thirty Dirhams. So Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘Does anyone know of it?’ I said, ‘No’. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So give her piece by piece, and do not let anyone know’.

text: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from Muhammad Bin Ziyad, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said: ‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> never took from the inheritance of a slave of his when there was a relative of his, and if they did not happen to be from the one for whom flows the Obligatory inheritances, so he<sup>asws</sup> used to hand it over to them (the other relatives)’.
